description: Edit an existing feedback item. content (Markdown - replaces the whole body; start from the item's current content to keep its mentions and formatting) and timestamp (video time in seconds) can only be changed on the connected user's OWN comments. add_tags / remove_tags apply the team's existing tags by NAME and work on ANY feedback item you can comment on (labels and statuses are collaborative - e.g. add the 'Done' tag to mark feedback resolved), except that replies take no tags: tag the thread's root comment instead. Provide at least one of content, timestamp, add_tags, remove_tags. Returns the updated item in the same shape as feedback_get (without replies).

add_tags.description: Tag NAMES to add (must already exist in the team)

content.description: New comment body in Markdown (fully replaces the existing body; own comments only). Same syntax as feedback_post content.

timestamp.description: New video time in SECONDS the comment refers to (own comments only)

name: feedback_update
title: Update feedback
